verdict: clear after independent source, lifecycle and exact native method-scope review
checks: Request identity includes category, encoded query, expected page, view and generation; stale responses cannot change current list or loading flag.
New first-page request clears old cards and pagination; failed page retries preserve filters and current admitted page.
Actual upstream metadata fields are used, including foreign year instead of language; all values use one UTF-8 encoding.
Foreign mainland choices excluded; exact Hong Kong/Taiwan values use validated broader television route and corresponding type/temporal schema.
Duplicate Volley cached/network metadata success cannot reset an active route or filter; malformed metadata permits a later valid schema.
View destruction invalidates state and cancels/stops only the per-view queue; callbacks retain owner weakly.
Pagination uses actual zero-based last item; no invented pages or total item count from inconsistent videonum.
Same native adapters/click handlers retained; list committed once and adapter notified after valid data admission.
limitations: Upstream individual country metadata remains unreliable; no title-based inference or server record rewriting.
Actual Android UI and RecyclerView event execution require device acceptance.
